functions.name: buy_coverage
functions.doc:
NEAR coverage. Attach at least the quoted premium; the excess, or everything on a refusal, is
 returned. Only the vault's registered owner can buy.

functions.name: cb_buy
functions.doc: Finishes a purchase. Returns the token amount to hand back (always 0 for NEAR, refunded here).

type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: claim
functions.doc:
Anyone may start a claim; the payout always goes to the coverage's owner. Re-validated now, not
 at report time (plan R23).

functions.name: deposit
functions.doc: NEAR capital. Token capital arrives through `ft_transfer_call` with `{"action":"deposit"}`.

functions.name: ft_on_transfer
functions.doc:
NEP-141 receiver: `{"action":"deposit"}` adds capital; `{"action":"buy", ...BuyRequest}` buys
 coverage in this token, paying the premium from the transferred amount.

functions.name: quote
functions.doc: The premium for these inputs, with every input and declared assumption (plan R9). Free.

functions.name: receive_slash
functions.doc: The registry sends a slashed attestor bond here; it becomes NEAR capital (plan KTD9).

functions.name: release_expired
functions.doc:
Anyone may call. For each coverage past its end and its claim reporting period, with no claim in
 flight, its remaining limit leaves the book's total and the concentration totals, so expired
 coverage stops holding capacity. Returns how many were released.

functions.name: withdraw
functions.doc: Burns shares for their pro-rata part of the book's capital. Refused while capital is locked.

capital.description: Underwriter deposits, premiums and slashed bonds, less payouts and withdrawals.

locked_until.description: No withdrawal before this block: the latest coverage end plus its reporting period (plan R24).

total_limits.description: Sum of the remaining limits of coverage not yet past its reporting period.

BuyRequest.description: What the buyer asks for. Sent as call args (NEAR) or as the `ft_transfer_call` message (token).

outcome.description: "paid", or why the claim was rejected.

claim_started_at.description: When the claim in flight started; a claim whose callbacks never arrive may be retried after CLAIM_TIMEOUT_BLOCKS.

owner.description: Payouts go here: the vault's owner at purchase.

paid_through_block.description: Exposure up to this block has been paid for or was recorded before the purchase: the next payout counts only what was recorded after it. Starts at the purchase block, moves to each paid change's block, so one change is never paid twice (found in review).

policy_version.description: The policy it was priced on (plan R10).

released.description: Set once its remaining limit has left the book's totals (`release_expired`).

assumptions.description: Declared underwriting assumptions, labelled as such.

RiskClass.description: The four classes of docs/CLASSIFIER.md, ordered from least to most risky, so that `class <= policy.max_risk_class` is the policy check.

TokenId.description: The token an amount is denominated in (docs/plans/2026-11-10-2106-feat-coverage-loop-testnet-plan.md R1): NEAR itself, or a NEP-141 fungible token contract. Coverage, premiums, capital, payouts and exposure are always in one token; nothing converts between them.
